rules: The occurrence ALWAYS keeps the raw status verbatim (historical_status); the Work Item status is a projection.

Any raw value equal to `done`/`archived`/`done_pending_archive`/`completed` sets historical_asserted_done=true and current_verification=not_revalidated — never an accepted result (I14). The assertion is a fact about the SOURCE and is recorded independently of which status the value projects onto.

`archived` projects onto `archived`, not onto `done` (DEC-AUP-0014 rule 3). An archive card records that a card LEFT THE BOARD; it is terminal and unverified, and reading it as completion is the silent totalisation I4 forbids. archived therefore carries asserted_done=true (the source did assert completion when it archived) while projecting onto a status that makes no completion claim of its own.

asserted_done may only be set where the projection is `done` or `archived` — the two statuses that can carry a historical completion assertion. On any other projection it is a contradiction the occurrence would carry forever.

A raw value absent from this table is UNMAPPED: producer0 (MUN-0040) projects it to `todo` with `unmapped=true` and keeps the raw string; DAT-006 requires that the bulk importer treat UNMAPPED as a typed refusal in tests until the value is added here in a new revision. Silent defaulting is the failure this table exists to prevent.

Revisions are kept, not replaced. Every occurrence records the revision that produced its projection (source_occurrences.status_map_revision); a replay of a batch imported under revision 2 must be able to ask for revision 2 and get byte-identical projections. Rows written under an earlier revision are NEVER backfilled to a later one.

prd_done.note: PRD accepted, implementation not started — a stage marker, not completion

paused.note: paused by decision; blocked is the closest Muneral state, the raw value carries the distinction

archived.note: Datarim archive card exists: the card left the board. Terminal and unverified — DEC-AUP-0014 rule 3 forbids projecting it onto `done`. Revision 2 projected it onto `done`; that projection is superseded, and the revision-2 artefact is kept so those occurrences can still be replayed exactly.

done_pending_archive.note: done but archive card not yet written

superseded.note: superseded by another task — an identity decision (merge/split) is REQUIRED before import closes the card (AUP-DAT-002)

absorbed.note: absorbed into another task — identity decision required, see superseded

active.note: observed once; treated as in progress

completed.note: synonym of done in older rows

absent.note: no status field in the source (e.g. a task-description without frontmatter status) — projected to todo, flagged, never asserted done

canonical.note: brief status of an init/task-description written at /dr-init; carries no lifecycle information (same treatment as `absent`); stale stage marker when an archive card exists (R-ARCHIVE); flagged: AGENT-0082 is already tracked as a live task

compliance_done.note: pipeline stage after QA, archive not yet written; closest open state, never asserted done; stale stage marker when an archive card exists (R-ARCHIVE)

deployed.note: production state not verified in this record; does not mean a review is under way

draft.note: unstarted draft; stale stage marker when an archive card exists (R-ARCHIVE)

implemented.note: code written, QA/compliance not recorded; stale stage marker when an archive card exists (R-ARCHIVE)

partial.note: partly done; whether work continues or has stalled is unknown

pending_operator_gates.note: waits on a gate (see `paused` -> blocked); raw word only: it is not a live operator-gate state (DEC-AUP-0010: no gates on the operator)

prd.note: PRD being written; prd_done maps to in_progress, so prd must not map lower (consilium role 1); stale stage marker when an archive card exists (R-ARCHIVE)

proposed.note: proposed, not accepted; stale stage marker when an archive card exists (R-ARCHIVE)

scaffold.note: scaffold started; stale stage marker when an archive card exists (R-ARCHIVE)

blocked_pending.note: F2 normalizes blocked-pending; waiting on a dependency, preserved as a historical projection, never a live operator gate.

promoted_to_active.note: F2 normalizes promoted-to-active; historical activation marker, not verified runtime activity.

negative_controls.expect: UNMAPPED → typed refusal in the bulk importer; producer0 → todo + unmapped=true + raw kept
normalized (trim, casefold) to `done`; raw string kept with its original spelling
projects onto `archived` at revision 3 and onto `done` at revision 2 — the same input under two revisions, which is what keeping revision 2 is for

revision_note: Revision 4 adds twelve non-completion source projections. Prior artifacts are retained byte-for-byte; no existing occurrence is backfilled. R-ARCHIVE is separately enforced only for newly imported revision-4 identities without explicit native transitions.
